Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars equipped with manual air conditioning

  • System: Air conditioning

  • Component: Air conditioning pressure switch

  • Fault: The radiator fan runs continuously at maximum speed, even when the engine is cold. The problem occurs immediately after starting the engine; after switching off, the fan continues to run for a few seconds. However, with the ignition on and the engine off, the radiator fan does not operate.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Air conditioning pressure switch connection faulty

• Procedure: Check the condition and correct operation of the air conditioning pressure switch and its contacts; if necessary, replace the component or restore the contacts.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, near the headlight, on the underside of the headlight.
    In this case, the air conditioning pressure switch was found to have an oxidised connection; following replacement of the component, the problem was permanently resolved.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1 hour.
